normalization_rules.canonical_id: EXACT: existing_city_spots_id / existing_canonical_id / canonical_id — first non-null. null kept as null.
normalization_rules.linkage_type: Jeonju: from linkage_type field. Gyeongju: from new_place_candidate flag + notes. Others: inferred from canonical_id presence + id_note.
normalization_rules.stops_flattened: Dict-by-day (Busan C-001, Gyeongju C-001) and list formats unified to list[stop].
normalization_rules.rn_canonical_ids: Single-field (Busan/Gyeongju/Seoul) and list-field (Jeju/Jeonju) both represented as primary canonical_id + optional canonical_ids_all.
normalization_rules.guide_locales: locale='multi' + locale_coverage → list. Single locale → [locale]. Always list.
normalization_rules.utility_locales: Dict {locale: bool} and list [locale] both normalized to list of active locales.
normalization_rules.utility_summary: summary_ko / summary_en / summary_ja / summary_zh-CN → {ko:..., en:..., ...}. Omit if null.
normalization_rules.stale_excluded: Not included in recommended_now. Preserved in excluded_stale_recommended_now array.
